policy: Selected autonomous-driving research with primary company attribution. Dates are first arXiv submission dates as displayed by arXiv, not media dates, revision dates or catalog discovery dates. Company labels include verified collaborators and do not imply exclusive ownership. Resource links and release status are reused from the paper catalog.
